title: 第189章 麋鹿一样的女孩和狮子一样的男孩
slug: 班级求生我是大客车内唯一男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

夏灵灵念完最后一个音节，狐狸面具下的脸直接白了几分，原本红润的小嘴巴也没了点血色。

她的太阳穴突突直跳，脑子也感觉有些晕晕的。

【POWerOverWhelming！-无敌】（SSS级、唯一）

①【主动效果：持续消耗大量精神力，指定单个目标免疫一切伤害。】

这技能的描述很简单，却又这么强。

它比SS级的【范围无敌卡】更厉害的一点便是，【无敌】能直接免疫所有伤害，并且只要你精神力足够多，你就能一直无敌。

而【范围无敌卡】只是提供一个能抵挡无限伤害的护盾。

地面上的金色表盘瞬间破碎，化作漫天金粉消散在风里。

顾屿脸颊的血珠终于滚落，砸在地面，形成一片暗红色的花朵。

小轿车里的老四身体重新开始抽搐。

刀哥的右手手刀带着‘呼呼’破风声，猛地劈向顾屿的喉咙。

‘嘭——！’

‘咔嚓——！’

顾屿的皮肤突然泛起一片金色的...龙鳞。

刀哥的手刀和龙鳞结结实实碰撞在一起。

金色的龙鳞没有丝毫变化，反观刀哥的手掌直接崩开了一小道口子，随着血液渗出，裂口处从白色缓缓向红色变化。

刀哥这一下，是真的准备下死手啊！

而此时的刀哥，没有关注自己的右手，只是愣愣地看着顾屿那变透明的金色龙鳞。

他以为这金色龙鳞是顾屿的天赋或者是什么技能。

顾屿看到刀哥手掌成刀劈向自己喉咙时，他以为自己死定了。

可现在，顾屿发现自己不仅没感到疼痛，反而是这囚徒的右手不断滴着血。

而且血液还滴在自己的右手上。

血液因为重力，渗入手掌和血清的缝隙里。

顾屿能看到，刀哥的手掌直接瘪下去了一块肉，也不知道有没有骨裂。

不仅是刀哥和顾屿愣住了，就连老二和老三都看傻了。

老二和老三不禁感到奇怪，这小子明明有能硬抗刀哥全力一击的能力，刚刚为什么不用出来？

还让刀哥一根根掰断自己的手指？

不疼吗？

可就在顾屿愣神之时，刀哥抓住机会，将顾屿右手握着的血清拔了出来。

顾屿的左手手指全部都骨折了，根本用不了力，而且刀哥的血液起到润滑作用，减少了摩擦力，刀哥很轻易就将血清给拔了出来。

刀哥握着血清就跑向黑色小轿车。

他边跑还边大声朝老二、老三喝道：

“摁死他！别他妈松手！”

“这小子可不简单！！”

顾屿看着飞速跑向小轿车的刀哥，眼睛瞪得很大，眼球里布满血丝，嘴里低声呢喃着：

After Xia Lingling finished reciting the last syllable, her face under the fox mask turned pale, and her originally red mouth lost all color.

Her temples were pounding and her brain felt a little dizzy.

【POWerOverWhelming!-Invincible] (SSS level, unique)

①[Active effect: Continuously consumes a large amount of mental energy, and the designated target is immune to all damage.】

The description of this skill is very simple, but it is so powerful.

What's more powerful than the SS-level [Range Invincibility Card] is that [Invincibility] can be directly immune to all damage, and as long as you have enough mental power, you will always be invincible.

The [Range Invincible Card] only provides a shield that can withstand unlimited damage.

The golden dial on the ground shattered instantly, turning into gold powder and dissipating in the wind.

The blood beads on Gu Yu's cheek finally rolled down and hit the ground, forming a dark red flower.

The fourth child in the car began to twitch again.

The knife in Brother Dao's right hand slashed towards Gu Yu's throat with a whirring sound.

‘Bang——!’

‘Click—!’

Gu Yu's skin suddenly glowed with golden...dragon scales.

Brother Dao's hand knife and the dragon scale collided firmly.

The golden dragon scales did not change at all. On the other hand, Brother Dao's palm directly opened a small opening. As blood seeped out, the opening slowly changed from white to red.

Brother Dao is really preparing to kill him now!

At this time, Brother Dao didn't pay attention to his right hand, but just stared at Gu Yu's transparent golden dragon scales.

He thought that these golden dragon scales were Gu Yu's talent or some kind of skill.

When Gu Yu saw Brother Dao's palm turning into a knife and slashing at his throat, he thought he was dead.

But now, Gu Yu found that not only did he not feel pain, but the prisoner's right hand was dripping with blood.

And blood was still dripping on his right hand.

The blood seeps into the gap between the palm and the serum due to gravity.

Gu Yu could see that Brother Dao's palm was flattened with a piece of flesh, and he didn't know if there were any bone fractures.

Not only Brother Dao and Gu Yu were stunned, but the second and third children were also dumbfounded.

The second and third children couldn't help but feel strange. This kid obviously had the ability to withstand Brother Dao's full blow. Why didn't he come out just now?

And let Brother Dao break off his fingers one by one?

Doesn't it hurt?

But when Gu Yu was stunned, Brother Dao seized the opportunity and pulled out the serum that Gu Yu was holding in his right hand.

All the fingers of Gu Yu's left hand were fractured and he couldn't use any force at all. Moreover, Brother Dao's blood acted as lubrication and reduced the friction. Brother Dao easily pulled out the serum.

Brother Dao held the serum and ran towards the black car.

As he ran, he shouted loudly to the second and third children:

"Press him to death! Don't fucking let go!"

"This boy is not simple!!"

Gu Yu looked at Brother Dao who was running towards the car quickly, his eyes widened and bloodshot, and he murmured in a low voice:
